attacks.name: Adamantium Slash
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.
|!wild| |*Pierce|: Change 1 of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| results to a Blank.

attacks.name: Claw Rush
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character may Advance |!range_medium|.
|!wild| |*Pierce|: Change 1 of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| results to a Blank.

superPowers.name: Frenzy
superPowers.body: When this character Dazes or KO's an enemy character with an attack during its Activation, after that attack is resolved, this character may use this superpower. This character Advances |!range_small| then makes an |*Adamantium Slash| attack. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Assassin Training
superPowers.body: This character may reroll 1 die in its attack or defense rolls.

superPowers.name: Big Sis
superPowers.body: When an allied |*Gabrielle Kinney| within |!range| 3 of this character is damaged by an enemy effect, after the effect is resolved, this character may Advance |!range_medium| Toward the character that damaged |*Gabrielle Kinney|. This character may move only once per Turn as a result of this superpower.
